compiled_state.title: As a DSO contributor, I want the design-md-additions-payload contract documented, so that the ui-designer and preplanning skill have an agreed schema for DESIGN.md token additions.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Ships the design-md-additions-payload contract at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md.
**Why**: Contract-first development discipline — the schema must exist before the ui-designer and preplanning orchestrator implement against it.
**Scope**:
- IN: Contract document defining the nullable design_md_additions field, wireframe session file version bump to 2
- OUT: Implementation of the emission and approval flow (draft-5)

## Done Definitions

- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md exists and defines a nullable design_md_additions field schema with token-type, token-name, token-value, and rationale fields ← Satisfies: sc-2 (sc-2: "DESIGN.md addition flow via preplanning, never via the linter")
- The contract references the existing UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD as the parent schema and documents that design_md_additions is an additive nullable field ← Satisfies: sc-2
- The wireframe session file version is bumped from 1 to 2 in the relevant schema definition ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Contract-first] This contract must be committed before draft-5 begins implementation to prevent implicit assumptions.
- [Backward compatibility] The design_md_additions field is nullable to maintain backward compatibility with existing UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD consumers.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
